item.title: Running TensorFlow on Docker
item.description: I wrote about this in an earlier post, How to Install a GPU Driver on CentOS. This one looks at how to run TensorFlow with Docker. 1. Check Which TensorFlow Version the Current CPU Supports On a CPU that does not support AVX instructions, running TensorFlow > 1.15 fails with Illegal instruction (core dumped).
